units.source_text: 我完全不用担心照片照坏，照相机是德国康泰时牌的机身和卡尔·蔡司牌的索纳一点五的镜头。

en.t: I had absolutely no need to worry that the photograph would turn out badly; the camera had a German Contax body and a Carl Zeiss Sonnar f/1.5 lens.

units.source_text: 即使我的技术和功夫不到家，镜头还是可以发挥性能的。

en.t: Even if my technique and skill were not up to the mark, the lens could still show what it was capable of.

units.source_text: 不管你是活人还是死人，是人还是物，镜头都不会觉得伤感，也不至于膜拜。

en.t: Whether you are alive or dead, a person or an object, the lens feels no sentimentality, nor does it go so far as to worship.

units.source_text: 大概是我的拍法没什么大问题，只能说是拍出了一张索纳一点五的照片。

en.t: Perhaps there was nothing very wrong with the way I took it; all I can say is that it produced a Sonnar f/1.5 photograph.

units.source_text: 遗容的照片能拍得如此丰满，如此柔和，也许是镜头的关系吧。

en.t: That a posthumous photograph could come out so full and so soft was probably due to the lens.
